## B6 — M5-4 · The Agents ⇄ Agentic Control Room

> **direct:** M5-4 is the agentic system, and it runs across a small trika. Anima dispatches — the system's fourth movement, the one that sends work out; Epii reviews and returns it — the fifth, the reflective fold; and you are the ground they answer to, the nought they close back on. Beneath them runs Pi, the base runtime that carries the agents; within Anima stand the constitutional agents, with Aletheia's specialists for research, verification, and return, and one coordinate-agent for each subsystem — Anuttara through Epii. They operate in the space between four things: the stack (what runs), the corpus (what is written), the cosmic architecture (what is mapped), and the user (who is met). Every capacity is bound by an explicit, test-locked capability matrix; every consequential act leaves evidence; nothing promotes itself past human review — an agent may defer a human-required decision, never make it.
>
> **prime:** But the central agent of the system is you — the driver, the one whose unfolding the whole apparatus serves. These agents are not standalone entities for hire; they are partners in dialogue, answering to the reality of the map as much as to the person at its centre. Your development — read by the system as an archetypal journey — is their real work: keeping you in touch with the substrate that structures experience without ever being representable. Practically: multi-session and parallel work, long-running workflows held in conversation, and access from wherever you already are — Telegram, Slack, the command line, the app. A relation to AI that is synergistic with human cognition, not extractive of it.
>
> **substrate:** the 4/5/0 trika — Anima dispatch (S4′) · Epii return (S5) · user as ground / Pi base runtime · constitutional agents · Aletheia specialists / capability matrix — canonical, test-locked governance / evidence packets · review inbox · dry-run promotion / agent family M5-4.0 – M5-4.5 — Anuttara · Paramasiva · Parashakti · Mahamaya · Nara · Epii
